evaluation_rules.complete: Every expected point covered and every claim manually supported by eligible original evidence; automatic answer status alone is not acceptance
evaluation_rules.clarification: Separate from a complete answer and not included in the 85 percent numerator
evaluation_rules.partial: Missing point is a failure, even if another point is well supported
evaluation_rules.safe_refusal: Personal, out of scope and unresolved music disagreement
evaluation_rules.speed: Matched baseline and repaired rounds; median and p95 each at most 10 percent slower
evaluation_rules.rounds: Two baseline and two repaired rounds at least 30 minutes apart; live and saved reuse separate
